notes.title: Winning Love by Daylight version 1.0 release (no more early access!!)
notes.notes:
Winning Love by Daylight is now out of Early Access, and episode one is now complete!
what does that mean?
here's the changelog:


------Version 1.0 Changelog-----
-Tonnes of typos and grammar mistakes fixed
-All eight characters romanceable
-A progression system that notifies you as you get closer to a character
-Several pieces of full screen art
-New characters illustrated
-Several new songs added
-30 distinct Milestones, with a few secret ones
-30 matching Steam Achievements (after being hotly requested by you all in the comments)
-A total of 55,000 words of gameplay content across 9 in-game days! 



What does this mean for the future of the game?
For now Episode One will stay on steam, and be free forever, and we're looking into continuing the story with a second paid episode (3.70$USD) in the future.

notes.title: Winning Love by Daylight version 0.4 now live!
notes.notes:
Version 0.4 of the Winning Love by Daylight Visual Novel is now live on Steam!

If your version auto-updated you may need to uninstall and reinstall if it fails to launch. (rookie error on my part, but it's fixed now, and you shouldn't lose saves.)



Changelog:

-Full day with Willow added as voted for by the community.
-Your Dad now has art which is based on the likeness of a fan.
-updated all fonts in the game to match the Webcomic
-two new songs
-One full screen art scene with Willow
-Added images that match when talking to girls via the computer, and light up green during their dialogue to emulate discord.
-Minor bug fixes
-Minor dialogue fixes (e.g Blade no longer uses masc pronouns when insulting you.)
